title: Our global operations and data transfer
description: Our services are a window to the world. They are primarily designed to help people share information around the world instantly.

crumbs.title: Our global operations and data transfer

toc.title: Our global operations and data transfer

runs: To bring you these services, we operate globally. >x< Corp., based in the United States, and >x< Internet Unlimited Company, based in Ireland, (collectively, “we”) provide our services. We have offices, partners, and service providers around the world that help to deliver the services.

Your information, which we receive when you use our services, may be transferred to and stored in the United States, Ireland, and other countries where we operate, including through our offices, partners, and service providers. In some of these countries, the privacy and data protection laws and rules on when data may be accessed may differ from those in the country where you live. We rely on various legal bases to lawfully transfer personal data around the world including the EU Commission approved model contractual clauses.
